topic: Browser test runs triggered manually from a Synthetics Private Location disappear without results
environment: Private Location image 1.71.0 (latest at the time)
Manual test run triggered from a Private Location
symptom_pattern: A manually triggered browser test run on a Private Location never shows results and disappears after more than 10 minutes. It still reproduced on the latest Private Location image after an earlier report.
root_cause: A known bug in the Private Location image, introduced in version 1.64. Engineering was investigating it, and no fix release date was available when the ticket closed.
resolution_path: The customer re-checked the latest Private Location image and could still reproduce the issue.
The TSE confirmed Engineering was actively working on a fix and that the behavior was introduced in version 1.64.
The TSE recommended the workaround of running Private Location version 1.63 or earlier, where the issue is not present.
The TSE said no additional traces were needed while the bug remained reproducible.
The TSE agreed to notify the customer when a fix is released so they can validate it, and closed the ticket at the customer's request.
info_needed: Whether anything had changed since the previous communication
Private Location logs from a time window where the issue can be observed, if the Private Location had been upgraded

qa_pairs.tse_question: Have there been any new developments or changes since the last communication, so the latest information can be told apart from earlier escalations?
qa_pairs.customer_answer: Nothing had changed. The customer had only checked the new Private Location image version and reproduced the failure, so they opened the ticket to ask about the bug's status.

qa_pairs.tse_question: If you upgraded the Private Location, could you collect and share its logs from a time when the issue is visible?
qa_pairs.customer_answer: The customer declined for now. They said new traces make no sense while the bug still exists, and they asked for roadmap details on the fix instead.

tse_approach.summary: The TSE asked what had changed since the last escalation and requested Private Location logs. When the customer explained the bug still reproduced, the TSE gave the identified regression version, a workaround and a clear statement on the fix status, then closed the ticket.
